data.gender_notes: Jamillah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'jamil' meaning 'beautiful' or 'handsome'. In Islamic tradition, Jamillah represents the embodiment of grace, kindness, and loveliness. The name is often given to girls in Muslim communities as a symbol of these cherished qualities. The name Jamillah carries the meaning “Beautiful, lovely, gracious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jamillah usually hope their child will grow to embody beautiful, lovely, gracious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
